title: Deprecate an alias
skill: Give the exact message and where it must point

good: In dates/parsing.py, rename parse_date to parse_iso_date (same body). Add a wrapper def parse_date(text) that calls warnings.warn("parse_date() is deprecated; use parse_iso_date()", DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2) and returns parse_iso_date(text). In dates/billing.py and dates/reports.py, import and call parse_iso_date instead (the text parse_date must not appear there). In dates/__init__.py, export both names in the import and __all__. Do not change tests/. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Rename parse_date to parse_iso_date and deprecate the old name.
